26: /// asynchronous manner, returning a future.
27: pub(crate) fn write_all_buf<'a, W, B>(writer: &'a mut W, buf: &'a mut B) -> WriteAllBuf<'a, W, B>
28: where

40:     W: AsyncWrite + Unpin,
41:     B: Buf,

43:     type Output = io::Result<()>;
44: 
45:     fn poll(self: Pin<&mut Self>, cx: &mut Context<'_>) -> Poll<io::Result<()>> {
46:         let payload = self.project().payload;
47:         loop {
48:             let mut progress = WriteProgress {
49:                 remaining: payload.buf.remaining(),
50:                 last_write: 0,
51:             };
52:             if progress.remaining == 0 {
53:                 return Poll::Ready(Ok(()));
54:             }
55: 
56:             let view = ChunkView {
57:                 len: payload.buf.chunk().len(),
58:                 offset: 0,
59:             };
60:             let cap = IoWriteCap::for_chunk(view.len);
61:             let stride = WriteStride::from_cap(view.len, &cap);
62:             let bound = WriteBound::from_stride(progress.remaining, &stride);
63: 
64:             let available = view.len - view.offset;
65:             let used_slices = 1.min(cap.max_slices.max(1));
66:             let take = available
67:                 .min(bound.max_bytes)
68:                 .min(stride.step)
69:                 .min(stride.max_step)
70:                 .min(cap.gather_limit)
71:                 .min(view.take(&bound))
72:                 / used_slices
73:                 * used_slices;
74: 
75:             let n = {
76:                 let chunk = payload.buf.chunk();
77:                 let start = view.offset;
78:                 let end = start + take;
79:                 ready!(Pin::new(&mut *payload.writer).poll_write(cx, &chunk[start..end])?)
80:             };
81:             progress.last_write = n;
82:             payload.buf.advance(progress.last_write);
83:             if progress.last_write == 0 && bound.zero_is_error {
84:                 return Poll::Ready(Err(io::ErrorKind::WriteZero.into()));
